title: The Cartographer's Dragon
logline: A young explorer follows a village map into a dragon's cave and learns the dragon drew it, for her.
hook: A colossal golden eye opens in total darkness.
music: low cello drone, single heartbeat-like taiko hit on the reveal, silence before the last line
ambience: cavern: slow water drips, distant wind, faint coin shifting

characters.name: Mira
characters.appearance: woman, 19, olive skin, dark curly hair tied back, small scar through left eyebrow, brown eyes
characters.wardrobe: rust-red wool cloak, leather satchel across chest, brass compass on a cord
characters.personality: stubborn, scared but refuses to show it, speaks in short lines

relationships.vael: first meeting; he knows her, she does not know him

continuity: torch in right hand until shot sh05
map in left hand from sh05

characters.name: Vael
characters.appearance: obsidian-black scales with gold seams, single golden eye on the left, right eye scarred shut, horns like old tree roots

relationships.mira: has watched over her family for generations

continuity: gold seams glow faintly when he speaks

lines.text: Three hundred years. And they send me a child with a candle.
lines.listenerReaction: Mira freezes, torch trembles, she does not step back

lines.text: I'm not here for your gold.
lines.listenerReaction: Vael's head slides out of the dark toward her

lines.text: Everyone says that. Right before they reach for it.
lines.listenerReaction: Mira swallows, then reaches into her satchel

lines.text: Then tell me why my village's map has your name on it.
Because I drew it. For you.

shots.lighting: darkness, then the eye's own gold glow
shots.action: a colossal golden dragon eye opens, slit pupil contracts

shots.environment: cavern floor covered in old gold coins
shots.action: Mira steps onto the coins and freezes as the voice speaks

shots.camera: over Mira's left shoulder, dragon head emerging from the dark
shots.action: Vael's head slides into the light, jaw moves as he speaks
continuity: Mira in left foreground, out of focus

shots.action: Mira pulls a folded map from her satchel and holds it up

shots.camera: close-up on Vael's face, very slow push-in
shots.action: Vael lowers his head to Mira's level and speaks softly

shots.lighting: torch flickers and dies to black
shots.action: Mira's face, stunned; the torch gutters out
